items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: So, the wind up, he sent his cousin, Leo. Leo Montrell.

ctx.x: I know him. He and I worked together at the other end for years. In other words, I broke him in at the other end. Oh, really? Yeah. I was thinking now. So, Brady bought me by Harry's one night. We got on the phone and we called and called. A lot of boys was afraid to come to Mississippi. Naturally afraid. We didn't want to come. We got on the phone. Yeah. So, the wind up, he sent his cousin, Leo. Leo Montrell. Yeah.
